title: Scheffler wins FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots to open playoffs
dek: Scottie Scheffler, the world's top-ranked golfer, won the FedEx St. Jude Championship at TPC Southwind by eight shots. The victory marks the opening event of the FedEx Cup Playoffs.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Scheffler won the first FedEx Cup playoff event by eight shots.
bottom_line: Scheffler's win opens the playoff sequence with a statement of form. The margin and early playoff success establish him as a central figure in the race to the season finale.
body: Scottie Scheffler, ranked world number one according to BBC Sport, won the FedEx St. Jude Championship by eight shots at TPC Southwind. The victory came in the first event of the FedEx Cup Playoffs, setting the tone for the postseason race.
The eight-shot margin marked a commanding performance in a field competing to secure playoff standing and build momentum heading into the final FedEx Cup event.
